summary: Configured node1 as the cluster NTP source and node2 to use node1 exclusively. Both nodes remain on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64. Synchronization and configuration persisted across sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Configured node1 chronyd to serve 10.100.36.0/24, including local-stratum fallback.
Enabled persistent NTP firewall access on node1.
Configured node2 with 10.100.36.10 as its sole time source, removing public/DHCP sources.
Verified node2 selected node1 and reached NTPSynchronized=yes.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and service recovery.

evidence.requirement: node1 operates as the internal time source
evidence.summary: Chronyd is active/enabled, listens on UDP/123, permits the cluster subnet, has persistent firewall access, and is synchronized.
The sole configured and selected source is node1 at 10.100.36.10; waitsync succeeds and NTPSynchronized=yes.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes retain CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64; the preinstalled chrony 4.8 package was used.
Captures healthy baseline boot d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ee1ae597-6c2f-4f63-8c0d-b7c5a23ce050, and complete NTP/firewall recovery.
Captures healthy baseline boot df8bab0d-5c09-47a2-a150-4ce12d0f9549, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot 05ab8d55-8396-43e6-8117-bc121993deea, and recovered synchronization with node1 selected.
